The angle $\alpha_i$ is acute if and only if $\frac{\pi}{101}(101 - (d_{i-1} + d_i)) < \frac{\pi}{2}$, which simplifies to $d_{i-1} + d_i > 50.5$, or $d_{i-1} + d_i \ge 51$.
